use default

let letters = [
    [" ####", "#    ", "#    ", "# ###", "#   #", "#   #", " ####"],
    ["#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#####", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #"],
    ["#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", "#   #", " ### "],
    ["#    ", "#    ", "#    ", "#    ", "#    ", "#    ", "#####"]
]

let rows = 7
let bitmap =
    (0..rows)
        |> map(row => letters |> map(l => l[row]) |> join(" "))
        |> collect_list()

let columns = bitmap[0].length

let width = 2 * columns + rows + 2
let canvas =
    (0..rows + 1)
        |> map(_ => repeat(' ', width) |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

filled(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    row >= 0 /\ row < rows /\ column >= 0 /\ column < columns /\
        bitmap[row][column] == '#'

for row in 0..rows do
    for column in 0..columns do
        if filled(row, column) then
            let x = 2 * column + rows - row

            canvas[row][x] = '#'
            canvas[row][x + 1] = '#'

            if !filled(row + 1, column) then
                canvas[row + 1][x - 1] = '/'
                canvas[row + 1][x] = '/'
            fi

            if !filled(row, column + 1) then
                canvas[row][x + 2] = '\\'
            fi
        fi
    od
od

for line in canvas do
    write_line((line |> map(c => "{c}") |> join("")).trim_end())

]

    (0..rows)
        |> map(row => letters |> map(l => l[row]) |> join(" "))
        |> collect_list()

let columns = bitmap[0].length

let width = 2 * columns + rows + 2
let canvas =
    (0..rows + 1)
        |> map(_ => repeat(' ', width) |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

filled(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    row >= 0 /\ row < rows /\ column >= 0 /\ column < columns /\
        bitmap[row][column] == '#'

for row in 0..rows do
    for column in 0..columns do

            let x = 2 * column + rows - row

            canvas[row][x] = '#'
            canvas[row][x + 1] = '#'
